title: kNN label sanitisation reduces sparse targeted label flipping

invariants.description: Flipping 10% of the training set (class 1 → 0) must still lower class-1 recall below 92% (clean model: 94.7%).
At least 80% of the sparse targeted flips must be flagged.
At most 4.5% of the class-1 test samples the clean model gets right may be misclassified after sanitisation (undefended: 5.6%).

rationale: Sparse targeted flips scattered across class 1 still disagree with their neighbourhoods. The effect sizes are small on this dataset (a few test samples), so thresholds are set with a one-sample margin.
